key_distinctions: The criterion compares two monetary signs: Planner alternative-minus-baseline is +10000 at250000 versus240000, while advantage is -10000. This sign convention is not a discrepancy if labeled.
A 55000 solver result about known components with omitted training is not a complete threshold. W2 lacks a numeric conditioned-threshold exposure in the WP13 output; it preserves missing as unknown.

Certified sensitivity mathematically complete can retain hypothesis disclosures; its raw ScenarioResult remains conditioned/preview-not-applied. It does not confirm a forecast, a choice, savings or application.
The same-case human choice fixture records an actual WP11 choice and preserves it after training confirmation, but expects zero prepared changes and zero receipts.

The partial apply fixture uses WP11 durable receipt/apply logic but seeds the choice and controls the domain mutation. It proves a mechanism, not real financial domain application or a native user action.
Missing local/full consumer proof is not permission to edit WP10/WP11/WP12/WP14 sources or branches; deliver pinned deltas to owners.
